settings.title: Dressed for the Field
settings.subtitle: Wear the birds. Pieces drawn from Pacific Northwest field journals — for birders, naturalists, and everyone in between.
settings.bird_panel_body: Every Atlas Dovy design starts with a sketch in the field. From Steller's Jays to Great Horned Owls, our prints are drawn from Mel's firsthand observations across the Pacific Northwest.

settings.title: Born from the Field
settings.body: Atlas Dovy was founded by Mel, a lifelong Pacific Northwest naturalist with a sketchbook always in her back pocket. Every design begins with time spent in the field — watching, listening, sketching.

settings.title: Rooted in the Places We Love
settings.subtitle: We partner with regional land trusts and wildlife organizations to protect the ecosystems that inspire our designs. 1% of every sale goes directly to conservation.

settings.title: Stay Connected to the Wild
settings.subtitle: Seasonal stories, new arrivals, and conservation updates — straight to your inbox.
